display_name: Amalfi Coast, Capri & Bay of Naples
display: Amalfi Coast, Capri & Bay of Naples
tagline: One of the world's densest premium passenger-ferry markets, where coastal road gridlock makes water decisively faster.
summary: The Bay of Naples and Amalfi Coast move enormous summer passenger volumes by sea — Naples↔Capri↔Sorrento↔Positano↔Amalfi on NLG, SNAV, Alilauro and Travelmar — precisely because the SS163 coast road is gridlocked and slow. Distances are short, demand is dense and premium, and the celebrity/luxury layer (Capri, the Amalfi grand hotels) supports a high-end foiling tier on top of the commuter ferry base.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the entire Bay of Naples + Amalfi network — Capri (~17 nm), Sorrento, Positano, Amalfi, Ischia, Procida — all short, dense, premium hops.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) links the bay to the Aeolian Islands and the Pontine archipelago on longer Tyrrhenian trunks.

competitive_landscape: NLG, SNAV, Alilauro and Travelmar run one of the Med's densest passenger-ferry markets today — overwhelming demand proof and partners. Summer crowding and road gridlock are the clear pains. No foiling incumbent.
seasonality: Strongly seasonal (Apr–Oct peak; some routes summer-only) but the Naples↔Capri commuter base runs year-round.
regulatory_note: Italian flag / EU; RINA certification; regional ferry concessions (Campania). Port operations split across Naples, Sorrento, Capri and Amalfi municipalities. Low-wake electric aligns with coastal-protection sentiment.
